name: pomegr
description: A local-first, read-only observer for coding-agent sessions.
author: Leandro Carvalho

scripts.build: npm run build:brand && npm run build:plugin && node scripts/run-vinext.mjs build
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build:plugin:claude && npm run build:plugin:codex
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run desktop:legal && npm run build && node desktop/build.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:prepare && node desktop/prepare-builder-cache.mjs && set ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=.electron-builder-cache&& electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 && node desktop/finalize-package.mjs
scripts.desktop:smoke: set NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1&& set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1&& node_modules\electron\dist\electron.exe desktop/smoke-runner.mjs
scripts.desktop:security: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/desktop-claude-auth.test.mjs tests/desktop-claude-usage-setup.test.mjs tests/desktop-security.test.mjs tests/api-serialization.test.mjs tests/desktop-shell.test.mjs tests/desktop-behavior.test.mjs tests/desktop-notifications.test.mjs tests/desktop-updater.test.mjs tests/desktop-runtime-seams.test.mjs tests/desktop-packaging.test.mjs tests/lan-network.test.mjs tests/lan-gateway.test.mjs tests/lan-sharing.test.mjs tests/vinext-lan-compat.test.mjs tests/lan-production.test.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: node --test tests/work-kind.test.mjs tests/provider-contract.test.mjs tests/provider-registry.test.mjs tests/provider-conformance.test.mjs tests/provider-fixtures.test.mjs
scripts.check:boundaries: depcruise vite.config.ts monitor app shared desktop web mcp scripts landing/app landing/worker landing/scripts --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err
scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:provider-contract && npm run typecheck:provider-adapters && npm run typecheck:landing && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:ops && npm run check:provider-docs && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run build && npm run check:generated && npm run test:plugin && npm run test:node && npm run test:ui && npm --prefix landing run test && npm --prefix landing run build:audit
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:smoke && npm run desktop:security
scripts.verify:desktop:ci: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:smoke:ci && npm run desktop:security
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:plugin && npm run test:ops && npm run test:node && npm run test:ui
